lines.t: (Intro)
[Fast banjo riff]
(Verse 1)
There’s a new song ringing in my soul tonight
Like a sunrise breaking through a heavy night
Yeah, I used to wander, trying to find the truth
Just wasting time, living in my youth
But the chains fell off and the doors swung wide
Now I got a holy joy inside
(Pre-Chorus)
Yeah, I'm letting go of the weight
Running to the cross, not a second too late
Oh, everything is changing now!
(Chorus)
And I wanna love with my heart wide open
Live for the One who's chosen me
Yeah, Your grace is a beautiful thing
Looking at my life, makes me wanna sing
Out of all the ways You could've shown Your grace
You brought me into Your embrace
And I never knew a love so true
Nobody loves me like You!
(Verse 2)
Well, the world’s gonna spin and the wind’s gonna blow
But I’m anchored deep in the hope I know
Every time I stumble, every time I fall
You’re the faithful God who answers when I call
Yeah, You take my ashes, make 'em beautiful
You take a broken heart and make it whole
(Chorus)
And I wanna love with my heart wide open
Live for the One who's chosen me
Yeah, Your grace is a beautiful thing
Looking at my life, makes me wanna sing
Out of all the ways You could've shown Your grace
You brought me into Your embrace
And I never knew a love so true
Nobody loves me like You!
(Outro)
Yeah, nobody loves me like You
Look what Your grace can do!
